lines.text: Their father said to buy more food, but Judah said they would not go without their brother.
Judah told his father to send the boy and offered to guarantee his safety personally.
Israel told his sons to carry a gift of honey, almonds and myrrh, and to take half the silver.
The steward told the brothers not to be afraid and brought Reuben out to them.
The brothers were seated by age, and Benjamin's portion from Joseph's table was five times larger than any other.
